title: Noncommensurate allocation.dt aliasing under actual RibaMod BMI stepping

source_mechanism.ribasim_bmi: BMI.update_until(time) computes dt=time-current and calls step!(model,dt).
source_mechanism.ribasim_step: step! runs update_allocation! only when the current step-start time is an exact multiple of allocation.dt, then advances the full requested dt.
source_mechanism.callbacks: create_callbacks contains no fixed-allocation boundary callback.
source_mechanism.ribamod: RibaMod advances Ribasim with update_until(MF6 current time) after each MF6 product step.

hypotheses: With allocation.dt=5 h and 6 h RibaMod/MF6 BMI advances, fixed allocation boundaries at 5, 10, 15 and 20 h are not executed because no BMI step starts at those times.
A5_S24 therefore writes only a t=0 allocation record through the 24 h product horizon.
Because its initial t=0 allocation is 32/0 and is never refreshed during day 1, A5_S24 reproduces the qualified DUMMY-20D A24_S24 stale-allocation trajectory within tolerance.
The aligned A6_S24 control writes allocation records at t=0, 6, 12 and 18 h and reproduces the DUMMY-20D A6_S24 trajectory.
The day-end total supplied UserDemand differs by more than 8 m3 between A6 and A5, demonstrating a hydrologically material consequence of clock commensurability.
This establishes call-start-gated fixed-allocation timing for the tested v2026.1.1 BMI/RibaMod composition; it does not by itself classify an upstream software defect.
